finish.hint: Untouched roles are played by bots

ending.note: A simplified simulation. Every number here is a placeholder, not a measurement.

storm.light: The surge came, and the shore held.
storm.medium: The surge came. The shore held in places and gave way in others.

verdict.thriving: The coast you shared is still alive. It cost each of you something, and it was worth it.
verdict.holding: The coast is holding, only just. The next years will ask more of it.
verdict.fraying: The coast is fraying. Each of you did what seemed sensible, and together it was not enough.
verdict.broken: The coast has lost most of what it gave you. Nobody chose this, and everybody helped.
